record.context_brief: Hyperbolic actions generated by codimension-k rotations
record.original_question: In Lobachevsky space of sufficiently large dimension, does there exist a discrete cocompact isometric action generated entirely by rotations around subspaces of codimension k?

evidence.quote: Consider the Lobachevsky space of sufficiently large dimension. Does it admit a discrete cocompact isometric action generated by (c) rotations around subspaces of codimension k?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{H}^n$ denote the $n$-dimensional Lobachevsky (real hyperbolic) space, and let $\mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ be its isometry group. A rotation around a subspace of codimension $k$ is an isometry of $\mathbb{H}^n$ that fixes pointwise some totally geodesic subspace $L \subset \mathbb{H}^n$ of codimension $k$ (equivalently, of dimension $n-k$) and acts as a non-trivial orthogonal rotation on the normal directions to $L$. A discrete subgroup $\Gamma \leq \mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ acts cocompactly if the quotient $\mathbb{H}^n/\Gamma$ is compact.

Fix an integer $k \geq 2$. The question is: does there exist an integer $n_0(k)$ such that for some (equivalently, all sufficiently large) $n \geq n_0(k)$, the space $\mathbb{H}^n$ admits a discrete cocompact subgroup $\Gamma \leq \mathrm{Isom}(\mathbb{H}^n)$ which is generated by rotations around totally geodesic subspaces of codimension exactly $k$?
artifact.status_search_result: Web search returned related results on reflection groups in Lobachevsky spaces (Vinberg, Nikulin: nonexistence of discrete cocompact reflection groups for dimensions sufficiently large, e.g. n > 995 noncompact, and arithmetic results for n > 15) and on convex cocompact groups, but no source directly addressing the existence of discrete cocompact subgroups generated entirely by codimension-$k$ rotations in $\mathbb{H}^n$ for $k \geq 2$ in high dimensions. The status of this specific question could not be verified.

status_evidence.title: On the classification of arithmetic groups generated by reflections in Lobachevsky spaces
status_evidence.snippet: Finiteness of the set of arithmetic discrete reflection groups in Lobachevsky spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Related context on reflection-generated cocompact lattices in hyperbolic spaces; does not address codimension-k rotations.

status_evidence.snippet: Computational tools for reflection groups in hyperbolic spaces.
status_evidence.claim: Adjacent literature on hyperbolic discrete groups, no direct result for rotations of codimension k.
